title_en: The Aircraft Set To Replace British Airways’ Boeing 777-200ERs At London Heathrow
title_zh: 该飞机将在伦敦希思罗机场取代英国航空的波音 777-200ER
summary: British Airways is preparing to retire 43 Boeing 777-200ERs, but which aircraft will take over at Heathrow?
summary_zh: 英国航空公司正准备退役 43 架波音 777-200ER，但哪架飞机将接管希思罗机场？
body_en: Passionate about promoting aviation, the beauty of flight and the science behind it, Antonio is an avid reader of aviation magazines and books, and he loves visiting airshows all over the world, taking photos and writing about airplanes and helicopters as well. He is currently based in Palermo, Sicily.

British Airways (BA) is about to retire the aircraft that built its long-haul network, but it has not told anyone exactly what will take its place at London Heathrow (LHR) . The airline ’s 43 Boeing 777-200ER s average roughly 26 years of age, according to Aerospace Global News , and most of them fly from Heathrow rather than Gatwick. The one firm date BA has given belongs to the other London airport: in a February 27, 2026 message to colleagues, CEO Sean Doyle said the first new Boeing 787-10 will be delivered to Gatwick in 2029, as published by the British Airways Media Centre .

So what is actually coming for Heathrow’s 777-200ERs? Two types dominate the picture: the Airbus A350-1000 , which is already stepping onto some of that flying, and the Boeing 787-10, with the long-delayed Boeing 777-9 expected to follow. One caveat before going further. BA has published neither a retirement date nor a route-by-route replacement plan for Heathrow, so every swap beyond Nashville described below is a possibility. The first real clue, though, arrived from the home of country music, and it hints at a bigger shift than a simple like-for-like swap. Read on, because the answer may change which jet you board on your next transatlantic trip.

Gatwick (LGW) is the easiest part of the puzzle to understand because BA has actually given it a delivery date. Aerospace Global News, citing Cirium data , reported that BA served 13 destinations from Gatwick in March 2026, all lower-yielding leisure flights, from Antigua and Cancun to Orlando and Mauritius, plus Accra and Islamabad for visiting-friends-and-relatives traffic. The same outlet notes that around 12 aircraft are typically based there and that some suggest 17 could be once the 787-10 arrives. The new jets are not expected to have a First cabin. The outlet also suggests that a larger Gatwick presence could make the airport more attractive to oneworld partner airlines hoping to feed connecting passengers into BA’s network.

There is also a technical twist. According to Turning Left For Less , BA’s earliest 787-10s lacked crew rest bunks and were range-limited, so the newly ordered aircraft will get an increased-gross-weight modification and bunks. The site lists Vancouver, Phoenix, Mauritius, Cancun and Las Vegas as routes that become workable. BA's newly ordered Boeing 787-10s will be powered by General Electric GEnx engines, following the airline's decision to introduce a second engine supplier alongside Rolls-Royce on its Dreamliner fleet. Doyle’s own message confirmed the bunks, and Aerospace Global News adds that the rest areas should be welcome news for crew, since the airline’s initial 787-10s do not have them.

That gives BA a relatively clean renewal path at LGW. Heathrow is harder. Most of the 43 777-200ERs are still tied to the airport, and replacing a four-class, business-heavy aircraft with a 787-10 without First would change the product as well as the capacity. Yet one Heathrow route has already provided a much more interesting clue.
The A350-1000 Is Already Replacing Heathrow 777-200ER Capacity

The Airbus A350-1000 is not merely a future possibility at Heathrow. As reported by Simple Flying , BA scheduled the A350-1000 to replace the 777-200ER on its daily Heathrow–Nashville service from March 29, based on schedule data first spotted by Ishrion Aviation. Published flight times stay at 9 hours 10 minutes outbound as BA223 and 8 hours 10 minutes back as BA222, although the A350 cruises slightly faster than the 777. In winter, the route has used the Boeing 787-8, and the report says there is no word yet on whether that aircraft returns once the cold season arrives.

Simple Flying's database shows the Heathrow 777-200ER on this route seats 272 passengers, while the A350-1000 seats 331, a jump of 59. The seat models are the same, but Simple Flying notes BA fits a smaller galley area to squeeze in the extra rows, and Turning Left For Less says cabin crew have voiced concern about galley space on the type.
Seat counts on Heathrow–Nashville, per aeroLOPA data cited by Simple Flying.

Economy passengers may even gain a little comfort, since the A350 has one fewer seat per row than the 777. But the strategic point is bigger: BA added 59 seats to a route without adding a single flight. Why would an airline do that, and what does it say about the rest of Heathrow’s fleet? There is also a cargo angle. Simple Flying points out that the A350-1000 is comparable in size to the Boeing 777-300ER and so has a significantly larger hold, which on a short transatlantic sector lets BA load more freight than before.
Heathrow Slots Make Upgauging More Valuable Than One-For-One Replacement

Because Heathrow is the one airport where BA cannot simply add flights. Writing in 2023, when the airline was still weighing its options, One Mile At A Time argued that Heathrow is capacity-controlled and that the larger A350-1000 and 787–10 variants offer excellent economics. They also noted that BA’s 777 fleet averaged nearly 20 years of age at the time, with nearly two-thirds of the jets delivered in 2001 or earlier, mostly the 777-200ER variant. Aerospace Global News makes a similar point about Gatwick: basing new jets there relieves pressure on a heavily slot-constrained Heathrow hub.

Efficiency is the other half of the logic. According to Airbus , the A350 Family delivers a 25% advantage in fuel burn, operating costs and CO₂ emissions compared with previous-generation competitor aircraft. That improvement comes from combining advanced aerodynamics, new-generation Rolls-Royce Trent XWB engines and lightweight materials, which account for more than 70% of the airframe. For BA, this makes the A350-1000 particularly attractive at a slot-constrained airport such as Heathrow: it can carry more passengers on an existing departure while benefiting from the efficiency gains of a newer-generation design.

That combination of capacity and efficiency helps explain why BA has ordered more than one type of new-generation widebody rather than choosing a single replacement for every 777. The order book tells the story. BA has 24 Boeing 777-9s on order after adding six aircraft in March 2025. It has also ordered six additional A350-1000s and 38 Boeing 787-10s, including the 32-aircraft order announced in 2025.

Those numbers make one aircraft particularly important. Twenty-four 777-9s are supposed to become BA's largest new-generation widebodies, but none has yet joined the fleet. The timing of that arrival could determine how quickly the oldest Heathrow 777s can finally disappear.
body_zh: 安东尼奥热衷于推广航空、飞行之美及其背后的科学，是航空杂志和书籍的狂热读者，他喜欢参观世界各地的航展，也喜欢拍摄有关飞机和直升机的照片和撰写有关飞机和直升机的文章。他目前居住在西西里岛巴勒莫。

英国航空公司 (BA) 即将退役建造其长途网络的飞机，但它尚未告诉任何人具体将由什么飞机取代伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR) 的飞机。据《航空航天全球新闻》报道，该航空公司的 43 架波音 777-200ER 平均机龄约为 26 年，其中大多数从希思罗机场而不是盖特威克机场起飞。英国航空公司给出的唯一确定日期属于伦敦的另一个机场：首席执行官肖恩·多伊尔 (Sean Doyle) 在 2026 年 2 月 27 日发给同事的消息中表示，第一架新型波音 787-10 将于 2029 年交付给盖特威克机场，正如英国航空媒体中心发布的那样。

那么希思罗机场的 777-200ER 究竟会带来什么？两种类型的飞机占据主导地位：空中客车 A350-1000（已经开始部分飞行）和波音 787-10，而拖延已久的波音 777-9 预计也将紧随其后。在进一步讨论之前需要注意一点。英国航空公司既没有公布希思罗机场的退役日期，也没有公布希思罗机场的逐条航线更换计划，因此下面描述的纳什维尔以外的每一次更换都是有可能的。然而，第一个真正的线索来自乡村音乐的发源地，它暗示着比简单的同类交换更大的转变。请继续阅读，因为答案可能会改变您下次跨大西洋旅行所乘坐的飞机。

盖特威克机场 (LGW) 是这个难题中最容易理解的部分，因为英国航空实际上已经给出了交付日期。 《航空航天全球新闻》援引 Cirium 数据报道称，2026 年 3 月，英国航空公司从盖特威克机场飞往 13 个目的地，全部是收益较低的休闲航班，从安提瓜岛和坎昆飞往奥兰多和毛里求斯，以及阿克拉和伊斯兰堡的探亲访友航班。该媒体指出，通常有大约 12 架飞机驻扎在那里，有人认为一旦 787-10 抵达，可能会有 17 架飞机驻扎在那里。预计新飞机不会配备头等舱。该媒体还表示，扩大盖特威克机场的规模可能会使该机场对寰宇一家合作伙伴航空公司更具吸引力，这些航空公司希望将转机乘客送入英航网络。

还有一个技术上的转折。据《Turning Left For Less》报道，英航最早的 787-10 飞机缺乏机组人员休息铺位，且航程有限，因此新订购的飞机将进行增加总重量的改装和铺位。该网站列出了温哥华、凤凰城、毛里求斯、坎昆和拉斯维加斯作为可行的航线。继该航空公司决定在其梦想客机机队中引入除劳斯莱斯之外的第二家发动机供应商之后，英国航空新订购的波音 787-10 飞机将由通用电气 GEnx 发动机提供动力。多伊尔自己的消息证实了铺位的存在，《航空航天全球新闻》补充说，休息区对机组人员来说应该是个好消息，因为该航空公司最初的 787-10 飞机没有休息区。
这为 BA 在 LGW 提供了一条相对干净的更新路径。希思罗机场比较难。 43 777-200ER 中的大多数仍然固定在机场，用没有头等舱的 787-10 替换四舱、重型商务飞机将改变产品和运力。然而，希思罗机场的一条航线已经提供了一条更有趣的线索。
A350-1000 已经取代希思罗 777-200ER 的运力

空客 A350-1000 不仅仅是希思罗机场的未来可能性。据 Simple Flying 报道，根据 Ishrion Aviation 首次发现的时刻表数据，英国航空计划从 3 月 29 日起在希思罗机场至纳什维尔的每日航班上用 A350-1000 取代 777-200ER。公布的航班时间为 BA223 出港 9 小时 10 分钟，BA222 回程 8 小时 10 分钟，不过 A350 的巡航速度比 777 稍快。在冬季，该航线使用的是波音 787-8，报告称，目前还没有关于该飞机在寒冷季节到来后是否返航的消息。
Simple Flying 的数据库显示，该航线上的希思罗 777-200ER 可容纳 272 名乘客，而 A350-1000 可容纳 331 名乘客，增加了 59 名。座椅型号相同，但 Simple Flying 指出 BA 配备了较小的厨房区域，以挤入额外的排数，而 Turning Left For Less 表示，机组人员已对该机型的厨房空间表示担忧。
根据 Simple Flying 引用的 aeroLOPA 数据，希思罗机场 - 纳什维尔机场的座位数。

经济舱乘客甚至可能会获得一点舒适感，因为 A350 每排的座位比 777 少一个。但战略要点更大：英国航空公司在没有增加任何航班的情况下为一条航线增加了 59 个座位。为什么航空公司要这样做？这对希思罗机场的其他机队有何影响？还有一个货物角。 Simple Flying 指出，A350-1000 的尺寸与波音 777-300ER 相当，因此拥有更大的货舱，这使得英航在跨大西洋航线上可以装载比以前更多的货物。
希思罗机场插槽使升级比一对一更换更有价值

因为希思罗机场是英航无法简单增加航班的机场之一。 2023 年，当该航空公司仍在权衡各种选择时，《一次一英里》认为希思罗机场是受运力控制的，而较大的 A350-1000 和 787-10 型号可提供出色的经济性。他们还指出，当时英航的 777 机队平均机龄已近 20 年，其中近三分之二的飞机是在 2001 年或更早时期交付的，其中大部分是 777-200ER 型号。 《航空航天全球新闻》对盖特威克机场也提出了类似的观点：在那里部署新飞机可以缓解航班时刻严重受限的希思罗机场枢纽的压力。

效率是逻辑的另一半。据空中客车公司称，与上一代竞争对手的飞机相比，A350 系列在燃油消耗、运营成本和二氧化碳排放方面具有 25% 的优势。这一改进源于先进的空气动力学、新一代劳斯莱斯遄达XWB发动机和轻质材料的结合，这些材料占机身的70%以上。对于 BA 来说，这使得 A350-1000 在希思罗等航班时刻有限的机场特别有吸引力：它可以在现有出发航班上运载更多乘客，同时受益于新一代设计的效率提升。
这种容量和效率的结合有助于解释为什么 BA 订购了多种新一代宽体飞机，而不是为每架 777 飞机选择单一的替代品。订单簿说明了这一点。 BA 在 2025 年 3 月增加了 6 架飞机后，目前已订购 24 架波音 777-9。该公司还额外订购了 6 架 A350-1000 和 38 架波音 787-10，其中包括 2025 年宣布的 32 架飞机订单。
这些数字使得一架飞机尤为重要。 24 架 777-9 预计将成为英国航空最大的新一代宽体飞机，但目前尚未加入机队。到达的时间可能会决定最旧的希思罗 777 飞机最终消失的速度。

title_en: Unresponsive Cessna Prompts Air Canada Boeing 737 MAX 8 TCAS Alert Over Palm Springs
title_zh: 塞斯纳反应迟钝，提示加拿大航空波音 737 MAX 8 TCAS 在棕榈泉上空发出警报
summary: An unresponsive Cessna triggered a TCAS climb alert aboard an Air Canada Boeing 737 MAX 8 departing Palm Springs for Vancouver.
summary_zh: 从棕榈泉飞往温哥华的加拿大航空波音 737 MAX 8 飞机上，一架反应迟钝的塞斯纳飞机触发了 TCAS 爬升警报。
body_en: Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

An Air Canada Boeing 737 MAX 8 received a Traffic Collision Avoidance System ( TCAS ) alert after encountering an unresponsive Cessna while climbing out of Palm Springs International Airport (PSP) last week. AC1769, bound for Vancouver International Airport (YVR), reportedly received a resolution advisory at approximately 11,400 feet, prompting its pilots to climb to 12,000 feet to avoid the nearby aircraft. The incident occurred shortly after the aircraft departed Palm Springs, with the smaller aircraft reportedly failing to respond.

Although the encounter triggered an automated collision-avoidance warning, the Air Canada aircraft continued its scheduled journey without diverting or returning to the airport. The 737 MAX 8 subsequently landed safely in Vancouver. While the incident highlights the importance of onboard collision-avoidance technology, several details surrounding the encounter, including the Cessna's identity and the minimum distance between the two aircraft, remain unknown.
Air Canada Flight Receives TCAS Climb Advisory

According to AIRLIVE , AC1769 departed Palm Springs International Airport at 12:45 PM local time on November 17. The aircraft, registered C-FSDB, was a 737 MAX 8 operating a scheduled service to Vancouver. It departed from Runway 31R and began its climb towards cruising altitude when its onboard Traffic Collision Avoidance System detected potentially conflicting traffic.

The reported encounter involved a small Cessna that was not responding as the Canadian aircraft climbed through approximately 11,400 feet. The TCAS resolution advisory instructed the Air Canada pilots to climb to 12,000 feet, representing an additional 600 feet of altitude. This maneuver was intended to establish greater vertical separation between the two aircraft and resolve the potential traffic conflict.

Importantly, the reported alert was a resolution advisory (RA), not a proximity warning. According to AeroSillage , an RA provides pilots with instructions to modify or maintain their vertical flight path to address a potential collision threat. The available reports do not establish the exact distance between the aircraft when the alert occurred.
How TCAS Protects Aircraft From Mid-Air Collisions

TCAS is an important layer of aviation safety, particularly when aircraft encounter potentially conflicting traffic in busy airspace. The technology uses information transmitted by nearby aircraft transponders to identify potential collision threats. Depending on the circumstances, the system can issue traffic advisories or resolution advisories, recommending that pilots climb or descend to increase vertical separation.

Unlike instructions from air traffic controllers, TCAS resolution advisories are generated automatically using onboard surveillance equipment. According to the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Aeronautical Information Manual, pilots are expected to follow an RA promptly unless doing so would jeopardize the aircraft's safety. However, the circumstances surrounding the Cessna's reported lack of response remain unclear. AeroSillage noted that the available reporting does not establish whether the smaller aircraft failed to answer a radio communication or did not comply with an air traffic controller's instruction. Its registration, the nature of the communication attempts, and the minimum separation between the aircraft have not been disclosed.

Despite the reported encounter, AC1769 continued its journey to Canada without an emergency diversion. AIRLIVE reported that the aircraft landed at Vancouver International Airport at 4:45 PM local time, completing the approximately two-hour-and-40-minute journey. Flight-tracking information independently confirms that this 737 MAX 8 operated the Palm Springs-Vancouver service and reached its destination. No other details or further emergency involving the aircraft were reported. Nevertheless, the incident illustrates how unexpected traffic conflicts can require immediate action even during otherwise routine departures.

Based on available reporting, no specific findings from the US or Canadian authorities have established the circumstances of the encounter. Without an official reconstruction, it remains impossible to determine whether the Cessna experienced a communication problem, whether an instruction was missed, or how close the aircraft actually came.
body_zh: 经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
加拿大航空的一架波音 737 MAX 8 飞机上周在从棕榈泉国际机场 (PSP) 爬出时遇到一架没有反应的塞斯纳飞机，随后收到了交通防撞系统 (TCAS) 警报。据报道，飞往温哥华国际机场 (YVR) 的 AC1769 在大约 11,400 英尺高度收到了决议建议，促使飞行员爬升至 12,000 英尺高度以避免附近的飞机。这起事件发生在飞机离开棕榈泉后不久，据报道，较小的飞机未能做出反应。
尽管这次遭遇触发了自动防撞警告，加拿大航空的飞机仍继续其预定旅程，没有改道或返回机场。 737 MAX 8 随后安全降落在温哥华。虽然该事件凸显了机载防撞技术的重要性，但围绕这次遭遇的几个细节，包括塞斯纳的身份和两架飞机之间的最小距离，仍然未知。
加拿大航空航班收到 TCAS 爬升警告
据 AIRLIVE 报道，AC1769 于当地时间 11 月 17 日中午 12 点 45 分从棕榈泉国际机场起飞。这架注册为 C-FSDB 的 737 MAX 8 飞机执飞温哥华的定期航班。当机载交通防撞系统检测到潜在的交通冲突时，它从 31R 跑道起飞并开始向巡航高度爬升。
据报道，此次遭遇事件涉及一架小型塞斯纳飞机，当加拿大飞机爬升约 11,400 英尺时，该飞机没有做出反应。 TCAS 决议建议指示加拿大航空飞行员爬升至 12,000 英尺，即额外升高 600 英尺的高度。这一动作的目的是在两架飞机之间建立更大的垂直间隔并解决潜在的交通冲突。
重要的是，报告的警报是解决建议 (RA)，而不是接近警告。根据 AeroSillage 的说法，RA 为飞行员提供修改或维持垂直飞行路径的指示，以应对潜在的碰撞威胁。现有报告并未确定警报发生时飞机之间的确切距离。
TCAS 如何保护飞机免受空中相撞
TCAS 是航空安全的一个重要层面，特别是当飞机在繁忙空域遇到潜在的交通冲突时。该技术利用附近飞机应答器传输的信息来识别潜在的碰撞威胁。根据具体情况，系统可以发布交通建议或解决建议，建议飞行员爬升或下降以增加垂直间隔。
与空中交通管制员的指令不同，TCAS 决议建议是使用机载监视设备自动生成的。根据美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 的航空信息手册，飞行员应立即遵守 RA，除非这样做会危及飞机的安全。然而，据报道塞斯纳缺乏回应的情况仍不清楚。 AeroSillage 指出，现有报告并未确定这架小型飞机是否未能应答无线电通信或未遵守空中交通管制员的指示。它的注册、通信尝试的性质以及飞机之间的最小间隔尚未披露。
尽管有报道称发生了遭遇事件，AC1769 仍继续前往加拿大，没有紧急改道。 AIRLIVE报道称，飞机于当地时间下午4点45分降落在温哥华国际机场，完成了大约2小时40分钟的旅程。航班跟踪信息独立证实这架 737 MAX 8 运营棕榈泉-温哥华航班并抵达目的地。没有报道涉及飞机的其他细节或进一步的紧急情况。尽管如此，该事件表明，即使在正常出发的情况下，意外的交通冲突也可能需要立即采取行动。
根据现有的报告，美国或加拿大当局没有具体调查结果来确定这次遭遇的情况。如果没有官方的重建，仍然无法确定塞斯纳飞机是否遇到了通信问题，是否错过了指令，或者飞机实际距离有多近。

title_en: How Much Narrower Economy Seats Get When Airlines Fly 10-Abreast Cabins
title_zh: 当航空公司飞行 10 并排的客舱时，经济舱座位会缩小多少
summary: Airbus and Boeing have been in a race to thin their cabin walls and make 10-abreast seating more practical for their flagship airliners.
summary_zh: 空中客车公司和波音公司一直在竞相减薄客舱墙壁，并让 10 人并排的座位对于他们的旗舰客机来说更加实用。
body_en: Aaron is an aviation enthusiast and world traveler with a deep interest in aerospace history and technology. He has traveled around the world numerous times, often incorporating visits to aviation museums and historic aircraft collections into his journeys. A native of New Zealand, he is an expert in aviation and maintains a broad interest in a variety of other subjects.

The discussion of how narrow economy-class seats are when fitted 10-abreast vs. nine-abreast is largely restricted to the Boeing 777 and Airbus A350 . These two aircraft cabins are sized so that they are variously configured nine-abreast or 10-abreast. The massive A380 was wide enough so that it was only fitted with 10-abreast economy seating. Nine-abreast was unnecessary for the Superjumbo, even for premium-heavy mainline carriers, while regulations preclude any consideration of 11-abreast configuration.

The A330 (including A330neo) and Boeing 787 airliners are typically nine-abreast aircraft, although some earlier mainline Boeing 787s were configured eight-abreast in economy. Today, Japan Airlines remains the only airline to configure its flagship Dreamliners eight-abreast . The A330 and 787 are not realistically wide enough for a 10-abreast configuration.
Both 777 & A350 Designed For Nine-Abreast Seating

Both the Boeing 777 and the Airbus A350 were originally designed for nine-abreast seating . The Boeing 777 was developed as a luxury long-haul aircraft that would offer relatively generous seat width with a 3-3-3 layout. This made it one of the more comfortable high-capacity widebodies. The original 777s came with an internal cabin width of around 19 feet, 3 inches (5.87 meters). They were all configured nine-abreast.

Later, Boeing 777-200LRs and -300ERs widened this to 19 feet, 3 inches (5.86 meters). The A350 followed almost two decades after the 777 originally entered service and followed a similar philosophy. But while it was called the 'Xtra Wide Body' (XWB), Airbus trimmed its width relative to the Triple Seven. Its width was considered spacious enough for a comfortable nine-seat economy configuration.

These Airbus A350s were built with an internal cabin width of 18 feet, 5 inches (5.60 meters). The old-production standard A350s were wider than the early Boeing 777s, but they also came at a later time when pressures for denser seating had increased. All these aircraft were physically and legally capable of fitting ten abreast (3-4-3), but airlines chose not to.

As a rule of thumb, low-cost airlines concentrate on regional travel with the Boeing 737 and Airbus A320 families. Long-haul international routes have been the domain of mainline carriers. Low-cost carriers work in a market segment that pushes for denser seating to reduce the cost per seat. Meanwhile, mainline carriers put more emphasis on premium seating and their premium brands. However, some low-cost carriers have moved into the long-haul leisure route market segment.

The two sister low-cost, long-haul, leisure airlines, Air Caraïbes and French Bee, have both purchased fleets of A350s. These are original production A350s, and both use the 3-4-3 (10-abreast) economy seating layout. This allows Frenchbee to achieve the A350-1000's maximum certified seat count of 480 (40 premium and 440 economy) . Air Caraïbes also has the same configuration on some of its A350-1000s.

The result is rather squishy. The published seat width for these economy seats is around 16 inches (41 cm). For reference, the industry average across the airline industry for economy class seats is 17 to 18 inches (about 43–46 cm). These two low-cost airlines are the only ones to have configured their old production A350s in this way. They can because their marketing is not so much concerned with onboard comfort; it's about getting passengers to far-flung leisure destinations as cheaply as possible. Just endure the flight.
Boeing 777-200LR & 777-300ER Trend To 10-Abreast

Historically, airlines configured their Boeing 777-200LRs and 777-300ERs nine-abreast (3-3-3), giving economy class passengers 18–18.5 inches (46–47 cm) in seat width. At the same time, market forces increasingly favored a high-density economy-class cabin. This generation of 777 was around four inches (nine cm) wider than the older aircraft.

Today, most of the world's 777-300ERs have been fitted or retrofitted to seat 10-abreast, cutting the seat width to approximately 17 inches (43 cm). Some carriers have resisted the trend , notably Japan Airlines, ANA, Korean Air, and Singapore Airlines. But most, including premium-branded airlines like Qatar and Emirates, are now 10-abreast.

But even with the nine-abreast hold-outs, it has sometimes not been for the want of trying. In September 2025, Korea's JoongAng reported , " Korean Air is reconsidering its plan to change the seating layout in economy class from a “3-3-3” to a tighter “3-4-3” arrangement after a mounting backlash from consumers. " Korean Air has not yet published a final seat map or official cabin configuration for its ordered Boeing 777-9 aircraft, but it would be surprising if it retains the nine-abreast configuration.

At 19 feet, 7 inches (5.97 meters), the 777-300ER was already wide enough for most mainline carriers to configure economy class 10-abreast. The incoming Boeing 777-9 and 777-8 (777X) come with thinner walls, allowing them to have a cabin width of 19 feet, 7 inches (5.97 meters). Boeing actively trolls Airbus and its A350, saying on its 777X product page, " Up to 40 cm (16 inches) wider than the A350 ."

The extra width will give the remaining holdout airlines more freedom to opt for the denser layout. ​​​​​In November 2026, Singapore Airlines announced its new 777-9 cabin with 17.6 inches (44.7 cm) for economy seats in a 3-4-3 configuration. The 777-9's cabin is wider and longer than the 777-300ER, but this will not necessarily increase the aircraft's density, as the vast majority of 777-300ERs are already 10-abreast. Ironically, the opposite is almost true because other market forces are pushing for more premium seating.

The Boeing 777-300ER is certified to carry up to 550 passengers in an ultra-high density layout. The 777-9 has more cabin space to fit even more seats, but Boeing is limiting its maximum exit-limit seat count by 75 seats (to 475) or by 110 seats (to 440), depending on the door configuration. Put another way, the 777-9 is envisioned to have more business and premium economy seats, while the already standard 10-abreast economy will benefit from a few more inches of lateral space. The economy class cabin is expected to shrink.
body_zh: 亚伦是一位航空爱好者和环球旅行家，对航空航天历史和技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他曾多次环游世界，经常在旅途中参观航空博物馆和历史飞机收藏。他是新西兰人，是航空专家，并对其他各种学科保持着广泛的兴趣。
关于 10 并排与 9 并排安装时经济舱座位有多窄的讨论主要限于波音 777 和空客 A350。这两架飞机客舱的尺寸各不相同，可以是九并排或十并排。庞大的 A380 足够宽，因此只配备了 10 个并排的经济舱座位。 9 并列对于 Superjumbo 来说是不必要的，即使对于优质的重型干线航空公司也是如此，而法规不允许考虑 11 并列配置。
A330（包括 A330neo）和波音 787 客机通常为九并列飞机，尽管一些早期的干线波音 787 飞机在经济舱中配置为八并列。如今，日本航空仍然是唯一一家将其旗舰梦想飞机配置为八并排的航空公司。 A330 和 787 对于 10 架并列配置来说实际上不够宽。
777 和 A350 均设计为九排座位
波音 777 和空客 A350 最初都是为九个并排座位设计的。波音 777 是一款豪华长途飞机，可提供相对宽敞的座椅宽度和 3-3-3 布局。这使其成为更舒适的大容量宽体飞机之一。最初的 777 客舱内部宽度约为 19 英尺 3 英寸（5.87 米）。它们都是九并排排列的。
后来，波音 777-200LR 和 -300ER 将其加宽至 19 英尺 3 英寸（5.86 米）。 A350 在 777 最初投入使用后近二十年推出，并遵循类似的理念。虽然它被称为“超宽体”(XWB)，但空中客车公司相对于三七飞机缩小了其宽度。它的宽度被认为足够宽敞，足以容纳舒适的九座经济配置。
这些空客 A350 的内部客舱宽度为 18 英尺 5 英寸（5.60 米）。旧生产标准的 A350 比早期的波音 777 更宽，但它们也是在后来要求更密集座位的压力增加的情况下出现的。所有这些飞机在物理上和法律上都能够容纳十架并排（3-4-3），但航空公司选择不这样做。
根据经验，低成本航空公司主要使用波音 737 和空客 A320 系列飞机进行区域旅行。长途国际航线一直是干线航空公司的领域。低成本航空公司所处的细分市场要求增加座位密度，以降低每个座位的成本。与此同时，干线航空公司更加重视优质座位及其优质品牌。然而，一些低成本航空公司已经进入长途休闲航线市场。
加勒比航空和法国蜜蜂航空这两家姐妹低成本、长途休闲航空公司都购买了 A350 机队。这些是 A350 的原始生产版本，均采用 3-4-3（10 并排）经济舱座位布局。这使得 Frenchbee 能够实现 A350-1000 的最大认证座位数 480 个（40 个高级座位和 440 个经济舱）。加勒比航空在其部分 A350-1000 飞机上也采用了相同的配置。
结果相当软。这些经济舱座椅公布的座椅宽度约为 16 英寸（41 厘米）。作为参考，整个航空业经济舱座椅的行业平均值为 17 至 18 英寸（约 43-46 厘米）。这两家低成本航空公司是唯一以这种方式配置其旧生产 A350 的航空公司。他们可以，因为他们的营销不太关心船上的舒适度；它的目的是让乘客以尽可能便宜的价格到达遥远的休闲目的地。只能忍受飞行。
波音 777-200LR 和 777-300ER 趋势为 10 并列
从历史上看，航空公司将其波音 777-200LR 和 777-300ER 配置为九并排 (3-3-3)，为经济舱乘客提供 18-18.5 英寸（46-47 厘米）的座椅宽度。与此同时，市场力量越来越青睐高密度的经济舱。这一代 777 比旧型飞机宽约四英寸（九厘米）。
如今，世界上大多数 777-300ER 均已安装或改装为 10 人并排的座位，将座椅宽度削减至约 17 英寸（43 厘米）。一些航空公司抵制了这一趋势，特别是日本航空、全日空航空、大韩航空和新加坡航空。但大多数航空公司，包括卡塔尔和阿联酋航空等高端品牌航空公司，现在都是 10 架并列。
但即使有九人并排的坚持，有时也不是因为缺乏尝试。 2025 年 9 月，韩国《JoongAng》报道称，“在消费者强烈反对后，大韩航空正在重新考虑将经济舱座位布局从“3-3-3”改为更紧凑的“3-4-3”的计划。”大韩航空尚未公布其订购的波音 777-9 飞机的最终座位图或官方客舱配置，但如果保留九并排配置，那将令人惊讶。
777-300ER 长 19 英尺 7 英寸（5.97 米），足以让大多数干线航空公司配置 10 人并排的经济舱。即将推出的波音 777-9 和 777-8 (777X) 具有更薄的壁，使客舱宽度达到 19 英尺 7 英寸（5.97 米）。波音公司积极攻击空客及其 A350，在其 777X 产品页面上表示，“比 A350 宽达 40 厘米（16 英寸）”。

额外的宽度将使剩余的坚持不懈的航空公司有更多的自由来选择更密集的布局。 ​​​​​2026 年 11 月，新加坡航空宣布推出全新 777-9 客舱，经济舱座椅尺寸为 17.6 英寸（44.7 厘米），采用 3-4-3 布局。 777-9 的机舱比 777-300ER 更宽、更长，但这并不一定会增加飞机的密度，因为绝大多数 777-300ER 已经是 10 架并列。讽刺的是，事实恰恰相反，因为其他市场力量正在推动更多的优质座位。
波音 777-300ER 经认证可在超高密度布局中搭载多达 550 名乘客。 777-9 拥有更多的机舱空间，可以容纳更多座位，但波音将其最大出口限制座位数限制为 75 个座位​​（至 475 个）或 110 个座位（至 440 个），具体取决于舱门配置。换句话说，777-9 预计将拥有更多的商务舱和高级经济舱座位，而已经标准的 10 并排经济舱将受益于多几英寸的横向空间。经济舱客舱预计将缩小。

title_en: SFO’s Airfield Will Flood Amid Thanksgiving Rush With 9-Foot Tides Predicted, Officials Say
title_zh: 官员称，SFO 机场将在感恩节高峰期间被洪水淹没，预计潮汐高达 9 英尺
summary: SFO faces Thanksgiving flooding as king tides and storm surge threaten its runways, with water levels potentially reaching 9.9 feet.
summary_zh: 由于大潮和风暴潮威胁其跑道，SFO 面临感恩节洪水，水位可能达到 9.9 英尺。
body_en: Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

San Francisco International Airport (SFO) is facing a significant coastal flooding threat during one of the busiest travel periods of the year, with officials warning that exceptionally high tides could overwhelm vulnerable sections of its airfield. The National Weather Service (NWS) is forecasting water levels approaching nearly 10 feet or potentially higher around San Francisco Bay between Tuesday and Thursday, coinciding with the Thanksgiving travel rush.

Unusually high king tides, storm surge, warmer ocean temperatures, and an approaching winter storm are raising concerns about the airport's ability to keep its airfield and surrounding infrastructure clear of seawater. Although SFO is preparing for potential flooding, the situation could create additional complications for passengers, airlines, and airport operations during the holiday period.

According to the Los Angeles Times , both SFO and Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport (OAK) are facing potential flooding as exceptionally high tides approach Northern California. NWS meteorologists warned of extreme coastal flooding along the San Francisco Bay shoreline, with water levels potentially exceeding nine feet depending on the storm surge. The forecast is concerning because SFO's seawalls are not uniformly high, leaving certain sections more vulnerable to overtopping.

According to Deep Arrival , NWS also warned that water levels along SFO's shoreline could reach approximately 9.9 feet (three meters) during the most concerning periods. The airport's seawall stretches for more than seven miles, but some vulnerable sections are reportedly only 8 feet high. The southeastern corner near Runway 28 Left is particularly exposed, while the northern ends of both runways also feature lower sections. It remains unclear whether the runways or taxiways themselves will experience flooding.

The airport is already preparing for the possibility of seawater entering its airfield. SFO spokesperson Doug Yakel said the airport was prepared to respond and maintain safe operations, according to Deep Arrival. Crews are clearing drainage areas, inspecting pump stations, and positioning sandbags and emergency flood barriers.
King Tides And Storm Surge Create A Dangerous Combination

The flooding threat is being driven by several overlapping weather and astronomical factors. The NWS explains that unusually high king tides, thermal expansion from warmer ocean temperatures, and storm surge are combining to push bay water levels toward historic territory. According to its forecast discussion on Sunday, major to extreme coastal flooding is expected, with an impactful storm forecast to affect the region on Tuesday and Wednesday.

The NWS predicts the San Francisco tide gauge could reach 8.4 feet on Tuesday, and 8.6 feet (2.6 meters) on Wednesday, above mean lower low water. Thursday's predicted level is 8.2 feet (2.5 meters). These figures include the forecast tidal conditions, with additional storm-related water potentially worsening the situation. The previous record at San Francisco's Crissy Field gauge was 8.66 feet (2.63 meters), recorded in January 1983, according to the Los Angeles Times.

The implications extend beyond airport infrastructure. Highway 101, an important access route for SFO passengers, could also experience flooding, potentially making it difficult for travelers and airport employees to reach the terminals. San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie has urged residents to avoid unnecessary journeys, particularly between Monday afternoon and Wednesday. The city is also suspending parking meter and time-limit enforcement during that period to help residents move their vehicles away from vulnerable areas, according to Deep Arrival.
Thanksgiving Travelers Face Additional Disruption Risks

The timing could hardly be worse for the airport, with Thanksgiving traditionally generating substantial domestic travel demand across the US . Any flooding affecting SFO's runways, taxiways, or surrounding access roads could complicate an already busy operating environment. However, officials have not confirmed that flight cancellations or runway closures will be necessary, and the airport is continuing its preparations to maintain safe operations.

OAK nearby is also monitoring the situation, although its infrastructure appears better positioned to withstand the predicted water levels. Deep Arrival reports that the airport has raised its perimeter dike to 13 feet (four meters), reaching 17 feet (five meters) in certain locations, and does not currently expect flooding. Meanwhile, the NWS anticipates drier conditions on Thanksgiving Day itself before another storm system potentially arrives during the following weekend.

Officials are urging passengers to monitor airline notifications and airport updates. The greatest concern is around late-morning high tides on Tuesday and Wednesday, when storm surge could push water beyond vulnerable seawall sections. Although flooding remains a forecast risk, not a confirmed operational disruption, the combination of high water levels and Thanksgiving passenger volumes presents a serious challenge for the airport and could disrupt travelers.
body_zh: 经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
旧金山国际机场 (SFO) 在一年中最繁忙的旅行期间面临着严重的沿海洪水威胁，官员警告说，异常高的潮汐可能会淹没机场的脆弱区域。美国国家气象局 (NWS) 预计，周二至周四期间，旧金山湾周围的水位将接近 10 英尺，甚至可能更高，恰逢感恩节旅游高峰。
异常高涨的潮汐、风暴潮、海洋温度升高以及即将到来的冬季风暴，引发了人们对机场是否有能力保持机场和周围基础设施远离海水的担忧。尽管 SFO 正在为可能发生的洪水做好准备，但这种情况可能会给假期期间的乘客、航空公司和机场运营带来额外的复杂性。
据《洛杉矶时报》报道，随着异常高潮逼近北加州，SFO 和奥克兰旧金山湾机场 (OAK) 都面临着潜在的洪水威胁。美国国家气象局气象学家警告称，旧金山湾沿岸将出现极端沿海洪水，根据风暴潮的情况，水位可能会超过九英尺。这一预测令人担忧，因为 SFO 的海堤高度并不统一，某些部分更容易被淹没。
据 Deep Arrival 报道，NWS 还警告称，在最令人担忧的时期，SFO 海岸线的水位可能达到约 9.9 英尺（三米）。机场的海堤绵延超过 7 英里，但据报道，一些脆弱部分仅 8 英尺高。 28 号左跑道附近的东南角尤其暴露，而两条跑道的北端也有较低的部分。目前尚不清楚跑道或滑行道本身是否会遭遇洪水。
该机场已经为海水进入机场的可能性做好了准备。据 Deep Arrival 报道，SFO 发言人 Doug Yakel 表示，机场已准备好应对并维持安全运营。工作人员正在清理排水区、检查泵站并放置沙袋和紧急防洪屏障。
潮汐和风暴潮形成危险的组合
洪水威胁是由多种重叠的天气和天文因素造成的。国家气象局解释说，异常高的潮汐、海洋温度升高带来的热膨胀和风暴潮结合在一起，将海湾水位推向历史区域。根据周日的预测讨论，预计将出现严重到极端的沿海洪水，预计周二和周三将有一场强烈的风暴影响该地区。
NWS 预测旧金山潮汐表周二可能达到 8.4 英尺，周三将达到 8.6 英尺（2.6 米），高于平均低潮位。周四预计水位为 8.2 英尺（2.5 米）。这些数字包括预测的潮汐情况，额外的风暴相关的水可能会使情况变得更糟。据《洛杉矶时报》报道，旧金山 Crissy Field 测量仪之前的记录为 8.66 英尺（2.63 米），记录于 1983 年 1 月。
其影响超出了机场基础设施的范围。 101 号高速公路是 SFO 乘客的重要通道，也可能遭遇洪水，导致旅客和机场员工难以到达航站楼。旧金山市长丹尼尔·卢里敦促居民避免不必要的出行，尤其是周一下午到周三之间。据 Deep Arrival 报道，该市还将在此期间暂停停车计时器和时限执法，以帮助居民将车辆移离易受影响的地区。
感恩节旅行者面临额外的干扰风险
对于机场来说，这个时机再糟糕不过了，因为传统上感恩节会在美国各地产生大量的国内旅行需求。任何影响 SFO 跑道、滑行道或周围通道的洪水都可能使本已繁忙的运营环境变得更加复杂。然而，官员们尚未确认是否有必要取消航班或关闭跑道，机场正在继续做好维持安全运营的准备工作。
附近的 OAK 也在监测局势，尽管其基础设施似乎能够更好地承受预测的水位。 Deep Arrival 报道称，机场已将周边堤坝加高至 13 英尺（四米），某些地点达到 17 英尺（五米），目前预计不会发生洪水。与此同时，国家气象局预计感恩节当天天气会更加干燥，下周末可能会出现另一个风暴系统。
官员们敦促乘客留意航空公司通知和机场更新。最令人担忧的是周二和周三上午晚些时候的涨潮，届时风暴潮可能会将水推到脆弱的海堤部分之外。尽管洪水仍然是预测的风险，而不是确认的运营中断，但高水位和感恩节旅客量的结合给机场带来了严峻的挑战，并可能扰乱旅客。

title_en: The 7 Largest US Air Force Bases By Land Area
title_zh: 按陆地面积计算的 7 个最大的美国空军基地
summary: A closer look at the biggest real estate in the USAF.
summary_zh: 近距离观察美国空军最大的房地产。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

The USAF has some of the largest and most famous military bases anywhere in the world. But when it comes down to size, the question is which one is ultimately the largest of all the air bases. In this article, we are going to break down the seven biggest pieces of real estate owned by the USAF anywhere in the world.

As the largest air force of any military on the planet, the USAF not only has thousands of aircraft but also numerous ballistic missile sites and extensive facilities to support operations and logistics. Let's get down to it and go down the list, starting with the smallest entry first.

Fairchild AFB is located just southwest of Spokane, Washington. The base is a critical component of the Air Mobility Command and serves as one of the largest aerial refueling hubs in the USAF. The host unit, the 92nd Air Refueling Wing, operates a large fleet of KC-135 Stratotanker aircraft.

The base is also home to the Air Force's only Survival, Evasion, Resistance, and Escape School. This facility trains roughly 20,000 students annually on how to survive being shot down and captured under the worst conditions possible.

The 36th Rescue Squadron supports both the SERE School and the entire Pacific Northwest region across a four-state area. The Air National Guard's 141st Air Refueling Wing and the Joint Personnel Recovery Agency, as well as an Armed Forces Reserve Center, are all located at Fairchild AFB.

Kirtland AFB is home to the nuclear command and Logistics arm of the Air Force Global Strike Command . The unit is a critical component of the US nuclear triad. The Space Force's Delta 15 is headquartered at Kirtland. The base is one of the largest employment sources in the state of New Mexico, with 20,000 personnel, including troops and civilians.

The base also hosts the Air Force Research Laboratory Directed Energy Directorate and the Space Vehicles Directorate. These units are focused on the development of advanced laser, microwave, and space-based technology.

The base supports over 100 mission partners and units. These include the Department of Energy's Sandia National Laboratories and Los Alamos National Laboratory, the Defense Nuclear Weapons School, and various Air National Guard and Reserve units.

Edwards AFB is very deep in the Mojave Desert of Southern California, where it is home to around people doing some of the most advanced flight testing and research performed anywhere in the world. The base hosts the US Air Force Test Pilot School as well as NASA's Armstrong Flight Research Center in the Air Force Research Laboratory. A number of government agencies and leading aerospace companies like Lockheed Martin, Boeing, and Northrop Grumman maintain permanent facilities on their campus.

Edwards is the headquarters for the Air Force Test Center. The bed of Rogers Dry Lake provides a 65-square-mile natural runway that offers a virtually perfect emergency landing area as well as a testing surface for many experiments. The base also has the largest anechoic chamber in the world for testing aircraft electronic and radio frequency systems.

Air Force Captain Chuck Yeager was the first human being to break the sound barrier when he flew the Bell X-1 rocket plane over the speed of sound at Edwards AFB in 1947. Since then, Edwards has been at the forefront of jet development, with the X-Plane series of increasingly faster supersonic prototypes being developed at the base.

The development of stealth technology also had its first steps at Edwards with the Lockheed Martin F-117 Nighthawk in the 1980s. Lockheed’s Skunk Works division also developed the F-22 Raptor and F-35 Lightning II at Edwards. Northrop Grumman tested the B-2 Spirit stealth bomber extensively at Edwards, and its successor, the B-21 Raider, is now flying over its airfield.

NASA and Lockheed are testing the X-59 QueSST (Quiet Supersonic Technology) at Edwards, which is working toward a low-boom design that will allow for renewed supersonic commercial aircraft development. It took its first flight at the end of October 2025. The base was even home to the NASA space shuttle program until 1991.

Located in the northwest corner of Florida, dubbed the Panhandle, Eglin AFB is the primary test and evaluation center for all USAF weapons, navigation, and guidance systems. This installation hosts almost 20,000 military, civilian, and contractor personnel from the Air Force, Army, and Navy. The Space Force also has an AN/FPS-85 radar on the campus for space surveillance.

The Air Force Special Operations Command has a large presence on the base, including the Air Force's only Reserve Special Operations Wing, the 919th. The 33rd Fighter Wing is located on the base, which is a joint training unit for both pilots and maintainers of the Lockheed Martin F-35A Lightning II.

To facilitate the weapons-centric mission of Eglin AFB, the base manages a vast overwater range extending into the Gulf of Mexico. McKinley Climatic Laboratory tests aircraft and equipment under severe weather conditions, and the Air Force Research Laboratory's Munitions Directorate calls Eglin home as well.

Hill AFB manages the Utah Test and Training Range, which is a 1,490-square-mile expanse of desert used for testing and tactical training. Hill AFB is home to the first F-35 fighter wing that became operational in the USAF, the 388th Fighter Wing. The 75th Air Base Wing is responsible for running Hill AFB facilities.

The Ogden Air Logistics Complex at Hill AFB manages the life cycle sustainment of the Lockheed F-22 Raptor, F-35 Lightning II, F-16 Fighting Falcon, C-130 Hercules, and A-10 Thunderbolt II. The command is also responsible for the Minuteman III Intercontinental Ballistic Missile.

The 419th Fighter Wing of the US Air Force Reserve is also stationed at Hill AFB. The wing flies the F-16 'Viper,' as the jet is nicknamed, and deploys alongside active-duty units to support combat forces. As many as 20,000 troops and civilians work on the base to support the mission of all the different units stationed at Hill AFB.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
美国空军拥有世界上一些最大、最著名的军事基地。但当谈到规模时，问题是哪一个最终是所有空军基地中最大的。在本文中，我们将详细分析美国空军在世界各地拥有的七大不动产。
作为地球上最大的空军，美国空军不仅拥有数千架飞机，还拥有众多弹道导弹发射场以及支持作战和后勤的广泛设施。让我们开始吧，从最小的条目开始，顺着列表往下看。
仙童空军基地位于华盛顿州斯波坎西南部。该基地是空中机动司令部的重要组成部分，也是美国空军最大的空中加油中心之一。其主机单位是第 92 空中加油联队，拥有一支由 KC-135 Stratotanker 飞机组成的大型机队。
该基地也是空军唯一的生存、躲避、抵抗和逃生学校的所在地。该设施每年对大约 20,000 名学生进行培训，教他们如何在最恶劣的条件下被击落和俘虏时生存。
第 36 救援中队为 SERE 学校和跨四个州的整个太平洋西北地区提供支持。空军国民警卫队第 141 空中加油联队和联合人员救援机构以及武装部队预备役中心均位于费尔柴尔德空军基地。
科特兰空军基地是空军全球打击司令部核指挥和后勤部门的所在地。该装置是美国三位一体核力量的重要组成部分。太空军的 Delta 15 总部位于科特兰。该基地是新墨西哥州最大的就业来源之一，拥有 20,000 名人员，包括军人和平民。
该基地还设有空军研究实验室定向能源理事会和航天器理事会。这些单位专注于先进激光、微波和天基技术的开发。
该基地为 100 多个任务合作伙伴和单位提供支持。其中包括能源部的桑迪亚国家实验室和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室、国防核武器学校以及各种空军国民警卫队和预备役部队。
爱德华兹空军基地位于南加州莫哈韦沙漠深处，这里是世界上进行一些最先进的飞行测试和研究的人们的所在地。该基地设有美国空军试飞员学校以及位于空军研究实验室的美国宇航局阿姆斯特朗飞行研究中心。许多政府机构和领先的航空航天公司（例如洛克希德马丁公司、波音公司和诺斯罗普格鲁曼公司）在其园区内设有永久性设施。
爱德华兹是空军测试中心的总部。罗杰斯干湖湖床提供了一条 65 平方英里的天然跑道，提供了几乎完美的紧急着陆区域以及许多实验的测试表面。该基地还拥有世界上最大的电波暗室，用于测试飞机电子和射频系统。
1947 年，空军上尉查克·耶格尔 (Chuck Yeager) 在爱德华兹空军基地驾驶贝尔 X-1 火箭飞机超音速飞行，成为第一个突破音障的人。从那时起，爱德华兹就一直走在喷气式飞机开发的最前沿，基地正在开发速度越来越快的 X-Plane 系列超音速原型机。
20 世纪 80 年代，爱德华兹公司的洛克希德·马丁公司 F-117 夜鹰也迈出了隐形技术发展的第一步。洛克希德公司的 Skunk Works 部门还在爱德华兹公司开发了 F-22 猛禽和 F-35 闪电 II。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司在爱德华兹对 B-2 Spirit 隐形轰炸机进行了广泛测试，其后继机 B-21 Raider 目前正在其机场上空飞行。
NASA 和洛克希德公司正在爱德华兹测试 X-59 QueSST（静音超音速技术），该技术正在致力于低吊杆设计，以便重新开发超音速商用飞机。它于 2025 年 10 月底进行了首次飞行。该基地甚至在 1991 年之前一直是 NASA 航天飞机计划的所在地。
埃格林空军基地位于佛罗里达州西北角，被称为狭长地带，是所有美国空军武器、导航和制导系统的主要测试和评估中心。该设施容纳了来自空军、陆军和海军的近 20,000 名军事、文职人员和承包商人员。太空军还在校园内配备了 AN/FPS-85 雷达，用于太空监视。
空军特种作战司令部在该基地拥有大量人员，其中包括空军唯一的后备特种作战联队第 919 联队。第33战斗机联队位于该基地，是洛克希德·马丁公司F-35A闪电II飞行员和维修人员的联合训练单位。
为了促进埃格林空军基地以武器为中心的任务，该基地管理着延伸至墨西哥湾的广阔水域。麦金利气候实验室在恶劣天气条件下测试飞机和设备，空军研究实验室的弹药局也将埃格林称为自己的家。
希尔空军基地管理着犹他州测试和训练靶场，这是一片占地 1,490 平方英里的沙漠，用于测试和战术训练。希尔空军基地是美国空军第一个投入使用的 F-35 战斗机联队，即第 388 战斗机联队的所在地。第 75 空军基地联队负责管理希尔空军基地设施。
希尔空军基地的奥格登航空后勤中心负责管理洛克希德 F-22 猛禽、F-35 闪电 II、F-16 战斗机、C-130 大力神和 A-10 雷电 II 的生命周期维护。该司令部还负责民兵 III 洲际弹道导弹。
美国空军预备役第 419 战斗机联队也驻扎在希尔空军基地。该联队驾驶的是 F-16“毒蛇”（​​该喷气式飞机的绰号），并与现役部队一起部署以支持作战部队。多达 20,000 名士兵和平民在该基地工作，以支持驻扎在希尔空军基地的所有不同部队的任务。

title_en: American AAdvantage Business Program: How To Earn Bonus Loyalty Points & Miles
title_zh: 美国 AAdvantage 商业计划：如何赚取奖励忠诚积分和里程
summary: American's AAdvantage Business program lets small businesses earn bonus Loyalty Points and miles on eligible airfare, and having the Citi AAdvantage Business Card makes qualifying easy.
summary_zh: 美国航空的 AAdvantage Business 计划可让小型企业通过符合资格的机票赚取奖励忠诚积分和里程，并拥有花旗 AAdvantage B
body_en: American Airlines offers a small business rewards program, known as the AAdvantage Business program . This is a great way to earn extra rewards for your travel on American, including qualifying for bonus Loyalty Points and miles.

Best of all, eligibility for the program is surprisingly simple, assuming you have the Citi® / AAdvantage Business™ World Elite Mastercard® ( learn more ). There’s often even a bonus for new AAdvantage Business members , making it even more rewarding.

In this post, I’d like to take a look at all of the details of the AAdvantage Business program, as many people find it to be quite complicated. Note that AAdvantage Business was launched in 2023, replacing the previous American Business Extra program, which no longer exists.

AAdvantage Business is the name of American Airlines’ business rewards program. This allows you to earn extra rewards in a business account, in addition to the rewards you can earn through your own AAdvantage account. Best of all, you have quite a bit of flexibility in terms of distributing the rewards. Let’s go over the details of how this works.
AAdvantage Business program rewards structure

The AAdvantage Business program has a pretty straightforward rewards structure, as it rewards members with both Loyalty Points and AAdvantage miles . With the AAdvantage Business program, you earn the following rewards, which will post within 72 hours of an eligible flight
AAdvantage Business offers the individual traveler one bonus Loyalty Point per dollar spent on eligible airfare (that’s not a redeemable mile, but just a Loyalty Point toward earning elite status)
AAdvantage Business offers the business one bonus AAdvantage redeemable mile per dollar spent on eligible airfare

Let me emphasize that business travelers only earn Loyalty Points through AAdvantage Business when the business is currently eligible to transfer miles, and that requires either having the Citi AAdvantage Business Card , or having at least five unique travelers who have credited flights to the AAdvantage Business account, totaling at least $5,000 in flight revenue, over the course of a year (the credit card method is obviously easier).
Just to clarify a few additional points about AAdvantage Business rewards

In order for a flight to be eligible to accrue with the AAdvantage Business program, you must book directly with American and add the AAdvantage Business number to the reservation at the time that you make the reservation, and designate it as a business trip; alternatively, an accredited travel agency may book travel on your behalf through its booking tool channel, and have the trip still qualify
Travel on partner airlines qualifies for the AAdvantage Business program, as long as it’s booked through American

The AAdvantage miles that the company accrues can be transferred to a designated member at no cost, and can be redeemed like any other AAdvantage miles; however, these wouldn’t earn you any additional Loyalty Points, so also wouldn’t get you any closer to earning more Loyalty Point Rewards
These rewards are all in addition to the standard rewards that AAdvantage members receive
AAdvantage members ordinarily earn five Loyalty Points per dollar spent on airfare
Elite members receive Loyalty Points bonuses — Gold members get a 40% bonus, Platinum members get a 60% bonus, Platinum Pro members get an 80% bonus, and Executive Platinum members get a 120% bonus
All Loyalty Points earned from flying also count as redeemable miles, so you earn as many redeemable miles as Loyalty Points

Just to be crystal clear, an Executive Platinum member ordinarily earns 11 Loyalty Points per dollar spent on airfare, while if enrolled in the AAdvantage Business program, they’d earn 12 Loyalty Points per dollar spent. There’s no reason to leave those bonus rewards on the table!
Qualifying for the AAdvantage Business program

In order to be eligible to participate in the AAdvantage Business program, you need to have a business in the United States or Canada with a Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) or Business Number. Even small businesses are eligible for this program.
body_zh: 美国航空提供小型企业奖励计划，称为 AAdvantage Business 计划。这是为您乘坐美国航空旅行赚取额外奖励的好方法，包括获得奖励忠诚积分和里程的资格。
最重要的是，只要您拥有 Citi® / AAdvantage Business™ World Elite Mastercard®（了解更多），该计划的资格就非常简单。通常甚至还会为新 AAdvantage Business 会员提供奖金，使其回报更加丰厚。
在这篇文章中，我想了解一下 AAdvantage 商业计划的所有细节，因为很多人发现它相当复杂。请注意，AAdvantage Business 于 2023 年推出，取代了之前已不存在的 American Business Extra 计划。

title_en: Here’s Why The Boeing 777X Won’t Let Pilots Take Off With Its Wings Still Folded
title_zh: 这就是为什么波音 777X 不允许飞行员在机翼仍折叠的情况下起飞
summary: A look at the huge twinjet's safety features.
summary_zh: 看看这架大型双发喷气式飞机的安全特性。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

The Boeing 777X cannot take off with its wingtips folded due to critical safety and aerodynamic reasons. The extended wingtips are essential for the 777X's designed lift and fuel efficiency. Taking off with them folded would significantly increase drag and reduce lift, potentially compromising the aircraft's safety during the critical takeoff phase.

While the 777X is physically capable of remaining airborne with its wingtips folded, it is strictly prohibited and operationally restricted from doing so by both design and regulation. The aircraft is equipped with escalating warning systems that alert pilots if the wingtips are not extended and locked before entering a runway. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certification requires these systems to effectively prevent the aircraft from taking off in a folded configuration.

The 777X uses a revolutionary wingtip folding system designed and manufactured by Liebherr-Aerospace at its center of excellence in Lindenberg, Germany. This system is a first for commercial aviation and allows the aircraft to maintain high-efficiency aerodynamics in flight while fitting into standard airport gates designed for smaller aircraft.

The 3.5-meter (approx. 11 feet) wingtips are operated by a complex actuation system that transitions them between folded (vertical) and extended (horizontal) positions. The movement is driven by a hydraulic power drive unit (PDU) and geared rotary actuators. The full transition takes approximately 20 seconds.

Once extended, the wingtips are secured by latch-pin and secondary-lock actuators. During flight, the mechanism is mechanically locked with a large bolt and electronically isolated. This ensures the wingtips cannot move even if there is a power failure.

A wider wingspan moves the wingtip vortices further away from the fuselage. This reduces the downwash on the wing, allowing it to generate more lift with less drag. The larger surface area creates more lift, reducing the thrust required from the GE9X engines to stay airborne. This results in a roughly 10%-12% improvement in fuel efficiency compared to previous generations and competitors.

The 777X integrates advanced aerodynamics with digital flight controls to deliver a ride that is significantly more efficient and comfortable than its predecessors. The extra span enables the 777X to climb faster and cruise at higher, more efficient altitudes where air resistance is lower.

Made from carbon-fiber reinforced plastic, these wings are thinner and lighter than traditional aluminum wings. This allows for the massive span without a prohibitive weight penalty. With GE9X engines, these aerodynamics result in lower fuel burn than competing aircraft like the Airbus A350 , and a 20% lower fuel consumption rate than the legacy 747, which it is designed to replace.

The 777X features Smooth Ride Technology, an advanced fly-by-wire system adapted from the 787 Dreamliner, designed to neutralize turbulence actively. Hundreds of sensors detect air disturbances in real-time. The flight computer then automatically actuates the control surfaces, specifically the flaperons, to damp vertical motion and pitch that passengers feel during turbulence.

The highly flexible composite wings act like giant shock absorbers, bending and flexing during flight to absorb gust loads rather than transmitting those forces directly to the cabin. Beyond the ride quality,the 777X offers a lower cabin altitude (6,000 feet) and higher humidity. These environmental improvements, combined with 40% less engine noise, help reduce jet lag and physical fatigue on long-haul flights.

The folding mechanism is not designed to handle the massive aerodynamic loads encountered during takeoff and flight while in the "up" position. Attempting a flight with them folded could lead to mechanical failure or the tips breaking off.

Boeing integrated multiple fail-safes into the flight systems to prevent such an occurrence. If the wingtips are not extended and locked, the aircraft's takeoff warning system (required by the FAA and EASA) will trigger a loud alarm when the pilot adds power.

Boeing implemented an electronic checklist that confirms the position of the wingtips. If the flight crew attempts to initiate a takeoff procedure, the system will indicate “ incomplete ” until the wingtips are extended. If the pilots begin to take off roll without extending the wingtips, the avionics in the 777x will no longer trigger an aborted takeoff once the plane reaches 50 knots ground speed.

Interestingly, Boeing had already explored folding wingtips for the original 777 in the mid-1990s, even patenting a design. However, that version was heavy and complex; the technology only became commercially viable with the advancements in materials and actuation seen in the 777X. Combining advances in new material science with the newly acquired archives of McDonnell Douglas made it a natural evolution to develop the next-generation Boeing widebody with folding wings.

In its 1997 merger with McDonnell Douglas, Boeing inherited the F/A-18 Super Hornet program. The pivotal deal that integrated decades of naval aviation expertise into Boeing’s defense portfolio. By combining with the storied warplane manufacturer, Boeing inherited a rich legacy of naval fighter jet engineering and design. Looking past the hornet, the annals of the McDonnell portfolio include the most mass-produced supersonic naval fighter ever made, the F-4 Phantom II.

In naval aviation, wing folding is often a manual pilot action verified by ground crews. For the 777X, Boeing automated the process to reduce pilot workload: the wingtips automatically fold when ground speed drops below 50 knots after landing. Unlike the Super Hornet, where a significant portion of the wing folds, the 777X only folds the outer 3.5 meters (11 feet) of its tip. This minimizes the weight penalty and places the hinge where structural loads are lower compared to a mid-wing fold.

The 777X incorporates " spill-over " benefits from military R&D, specifically in the use of high-redundancy sensors and fail-safe locking pins that ensure the wing is structurally one piece before the engines can reach takeoff power. Boeing had to prove to the FAA that its new commercial mechanism could withstand aerodynamic loads equivalent to a fixed wing, leveraging testing methodologies honed over decades of military carrier operations.

In 1995, Boeing patented a design for folding wingtips on the original 777, but the proposal was abandoned because airlines rejected the idea. The primary reasons for its abandonment were the added weight, reduced fuel capacity, and increased maintenance costs associated with the design.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
由于关键的安全和空气动力学原因，波音 777X 无法在翼尖折叠的情况下起飞。加长翼尖对于 777X 的设计升力和燃油效率至关重要。折叠起飞时会显着增加阻力并降低升力，可能会在关键起飞阶段危及飞机的安全。
虽然 777X 在物理上能够在翼尖折叠的情况下保持空中飞行，但设计和法规都严格禁止并限制其这样做。该飞机配备了升级警告系统，如果翼尖在进入跑道之前未伸出并锁定，该系统会向飞行员发出警报。美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 认证要求这些系统能够有效防止飞机在折叠状态下起飞。
777X 采用革命性的翼尖折叠系统，该系统由利勃海尔航空航天公司位于德国林登堡的卓越中心设计和制造。该系统是商业航空领域的首创，使飞机能够在飞行中保持高效的空气动力学性能，同时适应为小型飞机设计的标准机场登机口。
3.5 米（约 11 英尺）长的翼尖由复杂的驱动系统操作，可在折叠（垂直）和伸展（水平）位置之间转换。该运动由液压动力驱动单元 (PDU) 和齿轮旋转执行器驱动。整个转换大约需要 20 秒。
一旦展开，翼尖将由闩锁销和辅助锁致动器固定。在飞行过程中，该机构通过一个大螺栓进行机械锁定并进行电子隔离。这确保即使断电，翼尖也不会移动。
更宽的翼展使翼尖涡流远离机身。这减少了机翼上的下洗流，使其能够以更小的阻力产生更大的升力。更大的表面积产生更大的升力，从而减少 GE9X 发动机保持空中所需的推力。与前几代产品和竞争对手相比，燃油效率提高了约 10%-12%。
777X 将先进的空气动力学技术与数字飞行控制相结合，提供比其前辈更高效、更舒适的飞行体验。额外的跨度使 777X 能够更快地爬升并在空气阻力更低的更高、更高效的高度巡航。
这些机翼由碳纤维增强塑料制成，比传统的铝制机翼更薄、更轻。这样可以实现大跨度，而不会造成过高的重量损失。借助 GE9X 发动机，这些空气动力学特性使得燃油消耗比空中客车 A350 等竞争飞机更低，并且比其旨在取代的传统 747 燃油消耗率降低 20%。
777X 采用平滑乘坐技术，这是一种先进的电传操纵系统，改编自 787 梦想飞机，旨在主动消除湍流。数百个传感器实时检测空气扰动。然后，飞行计算机自动启动控制面，特别是襟副翼，以抑制乘客在湍流期间感受到的垂直运动和俯仰。
高度灵活的复合材料机翼就像巨大的减震器，在飞行过程中弯曲和弯曲以吸收阵风载荷，而不是将这些力直接传递到机舱。除了乘坐质量之外，777X 还提供更低的机舱高度（6,000 英尺）和更高的湿度。这些环境改善加上发动机噪音降低 40%，有助于减少长途飞行时的时差反应和身体疲劳。
折叠机构的设计不能承受起飞和飞行过程中处于“向上”位置时遇到的巨大空气动力载荷。尝试在折叠状态下飞行可能会导致机械故障或尖端折断。
波音公司在飞行系统中集成了多个故障保险装置，以防止此类情况发生。如果翼尖未伸出并锁定，飞机的起飞警告系统（美国联邦航空局和欧洲航空安全局要求）将在飞行员增加动力时触发响亮的警报。
波音公司实施了一份电子检查表来确认翼尖的位置。如果机组人员尝试启动起飞程序，系统将指示“未完成”，直到翼尖伸出。如果飞行员在不伸展翼尖的情况下开始起飞滑跑，则一旦飞机达到 50 节地速，777x 中的航空电子设备将不再触发中止起飞。
有趣的是，波音公司在 20 世纪 90 年代中期就已经为最初的 777 探索了折叠翼尖，甚至申请了设计专利。然而，该版本笨重且复杂；随着 777X 中材料和驱动技术的进步，该技术才变得具有商业可行性。将新材料科学的进步与新获得的麦道公司档案相结合，自然而然地开发出下一代带有折叠机翼的波音宽体飞机。
1997 年，波音公司与麦道公司合并，继承了 F/A-18 超级大黄蜂项目。这项关键交易将数十年的海军航空专业知识整合到波音的国防产品组合中。通过与传奇战机制造商的合并，波音公司继承了海军战斗机工程和设计的丰富遗产。除了大黄蜂之外，麦克唐纳产品组合的历史还包括有史以来批量生产最多的超音速海军战斗机——F-4“幻影 II”。
在海军航空中，机翼折叠通常是由地勤人员验证的手动飞行员动作。对于 777X，波音公司自动化了该过程以减少飞行员的工作量：当着陆后地面速度降至 50 节以下时，翼尖会自动折叠。与“超级大黄蜂”机翼的大部分可折叠不同，777X 仅可折叠其尖端外部 3.5 米（11 英尺）。这最大限度地减少了重量损失，并将铰链放置在结构载荷低于中翼折叠的位置。
777X 融合了军事研发的“溢出”优势，特别是使用高冗余传感器和故障安全锁定销，确保在发动机达到起飞功率之前机翼在结构上是一体的。波音公司必须向美国联邦航空局证明，其新的商业机制可以承受相当于固定翼的空气动力载荷，利用数十年来军用航母运营中磨练出来的测试方法。
1995 年，波音公司为原 777 的折叠翼尖设计申请了专利，但由于航空公司拒绝了该想法，该提案被放弃。放弃的主要原因是与设计相关的重量增加、燃料容量减少以及维护成本增加。

title_en: How Many Flight Attendants Do Airlines Typically Hire In A Year?
title_zh: 航空公司通常一年雇用多少名空乘人员？
summary: It depends on operational requirements, at the end of the day.
summary_zh: 归根结底，这取决于操作要求。
body_en: Writer - Patricia joins Simple Flying with over 20 years of experience in aviation. She has served as cabin crew on flights from economy-class through to first-class and on private jets as well as being head of cabin crew and cabin safety focal point. Patricia has a master's level postgraduate diploma in Human Factors in Aviation and has written about aviation since 2010. Based in Dubai/Cyprus.

Cabin crew or flight attendant recruitment has always been extremely competitive, with thousands of people applying for a relatively small number of jobs. Only a very small percentage make it through the complicated hiring process, and it's well known that it is easier to get into Harvard than to get a flight attendant job. Only between one and four percent of all applicants get the job.

This guide will look into the facts and figures around airlines and recruitment numbers and what we can expect in the coming years. Will there be a shortage of cabin crew, and will the recruitment process have to change? How many cabin crew do airlines typically hire in a year?

Across the aviation industry in the US, airlines generate around 18,500 flight attendant job openings per year on average. Each airline's hiring varies depending on fleet size, route expansion, and annual attrition rates. Major carriers such as Delta Air Lines, American Airlines, United Airlines, and Emirates routinely recruit between 1,000 and 5,000 new cabin crew members each year. This can rise up to 8,000 during major post-downturn or surges in fleet delivery.

In contrast, smaller regional and low-cost airlines generally hire anywhere from a few hundred to around 1,000 cabin crew annually. This covers base growth and typical turnover rates of around 4% to 8%. Major carriers often receive upwards of 100,000 applications for just a few thousand spots, so hiring occurs in competitive, periodic windows that match aircraft deliveries and seasonal travel demand.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics states that there were 133,700 flight attendant jobs in 2025, and the employment of flight attendants is projected to grow 9 percent from 2025 to 2035, much faster than the average occupation. Many of those openings are expected to result from the need to replace workers who transfer to different occupations or exit the labor force, for example, when retiring.

Despite the growing need for flight attendants, acceptance rates are extremely low, with 90% of applications being filtered out at the very first stage. Only 1% to 4% of applicants make the grade, and even then, not everyone completes training. It is a highly competitive career with many hoops to jump through. Emirates reportedly receives over 15,000 cabin crew applications every month, according to Vertas Management . Just one percent of the more than 100,000 applicants get the job, according to Delta's hiring records obtained by FOX News . Major carriers like Delta frequently receive over 100,000 applications for roughly 1,000 to 1,200 roles.

The multi-stage screening process can take months, including screening, interviews, assessment days, online assessments, security checks, and medical checks, and often takes between three and six months. Even after that, there is a six- to eight-week training course that is heavily focused on safety and emergency procedures and aircraft equipment. Exam pass marks are very high, and there are only two chances to pass. Each batch usually loses a quarter of trainees during training.

Airlines are very picky about their crew members and expect high standards of safety and customer service. Personal presentation is extremely important too, as cabin crew are the face of the airline and represent the brand as a whole. Airlines can afford to be extremely selective about who they hire because they know there will always be plenty of candidates available. Some people don't understand the true nature of the job and may leave during training or probation because it's not what they thought it would be.

In January 2024, Emirates announced it was recruiting 5,000 cabin crew for 2024 to coincide with the arrival of the new A350 fleet. In 2023, they hired 8,000 cabin crew in 353 cities worldwide, creating a large and diverse workforce of 21,500 cabin crew as of August 2023. They are now estimated to have over 27,000 cabin crew. Emirates has reportedly changed its reapplication process from three months to six months, so a candidate can now apply only twice a year instead of four times a year.

American Airlines now employs just over 30,000 flight attendants, making it one of the largest cabin crew workforces of any airline in the world. The figure puts American ahead of rivals Delta and United, which each employ around 28,000 to 30,000 flight attendants. Southwest Airlines has around 20,000 flight attendants .

In 2025, Lufthansa recruited more than 2,000 flight attendants, according to Aeronews . Ryanair has over 16,000 flight attendants and is still recruiting for cabin crew. Qantas plans to recruit 600 flight attendants within five years to support its growing international network, according to Aerviva . The airline has also opened up a new base in Singapore. British Airways currently has around 15,000 cabin crew, with 12,000 being based at Heathrow, covering both short-haul and long-haul routes.

According to Aerviva , forecasts predict the need for over 1 million new cabin crew members through 2045, yet acceptance rates at major airlines remain under 5%. The International Air Transport Association (IATA) reports that international passenger travel demand is up 7.1% year-on-year and that it will double in the next two decades.

Boeing has also forecasted a demand for 1.02 million cabin crew members through to 2045, with around 40,000 openings every year to support fleet growth and replace retired crew or those who move to a different occupation. The global commercial aircraft fleet is projected to grow 2.4% annually through 2035, with widebody deliveries surging, particularly for US and Middle Eastern airlines.

Under EASA and FAA regulations, one flight attendant per 50 passenger seats is required legally for safety in commercial operations. Taking that into consideration, and with expected aircraft deliveries, India and South Asia alone will need around 51,000 new cabin crew by 2044 as their fleets treble.

Delta describes a seven-week onsite training program in Atlanta for successful candidates. The airline's hiring process includes an application, assessment, virtual job tryout, on-demand interview, event-day interview, and a conditional job offer before training. Delta also states that its application window opens and closes according to operational needs. Candidates who are not selected should follow the reapplication period shown in the current requisition. Most airlines ask candidates to wait at least three to six months before reapplying.
body_zh: 作家 - Patricia 加入 Simple Flying 时拥有 20 多年的航空经验。她曾在从经济舱到头等舱的航班以及私人飞机上担任机组人员，并担任机组人员负责人和客舱安全协调员。 Patricia 拥有航空人为因素硕士学位研究生文凭，自 2010 年以来一直撰写有关航空的文章。居住在迪拜/塞浦路斯。
空乘人员或空乘人员的招聘竞争一直非常激烈，成千上万的人申请相对较少的职位。只有极少数人能够通过复杂的招聘流程，而且众所周知，进入哈佛比找到一份空乘工作更容易。只有百分之一到百分之四的申请人得到这份工作。
本指南将探讨有关航空公司和招聘人数的事实和数据，以及我们对未来几年的预期。空乘人员是否会短缺，招聘流程是否需要改变？航空公司通常每年雇用多少机组人员？
在美国航空业，航空公司平均每年创造约 18,500 个空乘人员职位空缺。每家航空公司的招聘情况因机队规模、航线扩张和年度流失率而异。达美航空、美国航空、联合航空和阿联酋航空等主要航空公司每年都会招募 1,000 至 5,000 名新机组人员。在经济大衰退或车队交付量激增期间，这一数字可能会上升至 8,000。
相比之下，规模较小的支线航空公司和低成本航空公司通常每年雇用数百至 1,000 名左右的机组人员。这涵盖了 4% 至 8% 左右的基本增长率和典型流动率。大型航空公司通常会收到超过 100,000 份申请，但只有几千个名额，因此招聘是在竞争性的、定期的窗口进行的，以匹配飞机交付和季节性旅行需求。
美国劳工统计局表示，2025年将有133,700个空乘人员职位，预计2025年至2035年空乘人员就业人数将增长9%，远快于平均职业。预计其中许多职位空缺是由于需要替换那些转行到不同职业或退出劳动力市场（例如退休时）的工人。

尽管对空乘人员的需求不断增长，但录取率极低，90% 的申请在第一阶段就被过滤掉。只有 1% 到 4% 的申请者能够取得成绩，即使如此，也不是每个人都能完成培训。这是一个竞争激烈的职业，需要克服许多障碍。据 Vertas Management 称，阿联酋航空每月收到超过 15,000 份空乘人员申请。根据福克斯新闻获得的达美航空招聘记录，在超过 100,000 名申请者中，只有百分之一获得这份工作。像达美航空这样的主要航空公司经常收到超过 100,000 份针对大约 1,000 到 1,200 个职位的申请。
多阶段筛选过程可能需要数月时间，包括筛选、面试、评估日、在线评估、安全检查和体检，通常需要三到六个月。即使在那之后，还有一个为期六到八周的培训课程，重点关注安全和应急程序以及飞机设备。考试通过分数非常高，而且只有两次通过的机会。每批次在培训期间通常会损失四分之一的学员。
航空公司对机组人员非常挑剔，并期望高标准的安全和客户服务。个人表现也非常重要，因为机组人员是航空公司的形象，代表着整个品牌。航空公司可以对雇用人员进行严格挑选，因为他们知道总会有大量的候选人可用。有些人不了解工作的真正性质，可能会在培训或试用期间离开，因为这不是他们想象的那样。

2024 年 1 月，阿联酋航空宣布将在 2024 年招募 5,000 名机组人员，以配合新 A350 机队的到来。 2023 年，他们在全球 353 个城市雇佣了 8,000 名机组人员，截至 2023 年 8 月，他们拥有 21,500 名机组人员，规模庞大且多元化。目前估计他们拥有超过 27,000 名机组人员。据报道，阿联酋航空已将重新申请流程从三个月改为六个月，因此候选人现在每年只能申请两次，而不是每年四次。
美国航空目前拥有超过 30,000 名空乘人员，是全球航空公司中客舱服务员数量最多的公司之一。这一数字使美国航空领先于竞争对手达美航空和联合航空，这两家公司各自雇用了约 28,000 至 30,000 名空乘人员。西南航空拥有约 20,000 名空乘人员。
据 Aeronews 报道，到 2025 年，汉莎航空招聘了 2000 多名空乘人员。瑞安航空拥有超过 16,000 名空乘人员，并且仍在招募机组人员。据 Aerviva 称，澳洲航空计划在五年内招聘 600 名空乘人员，以支持其不断发展的国际网络。该航空公司还在新加坡开设了一个新基地。英国航空目前拥有约 15,000 名机组人员，其中 12,000 名常驻希思罗机场，覆盖短途和长途航线。
据 Aerviva 称，预计到 2045 年，新空乘人员的需求将超过 100 万，但主要航空公司的录取率仍低于 5%。国际航空运输协会 (IATA) 报告称，国际旅客旅行需求同比增长 7.1%，未来二十年将翻一番。
波音公司还预测，到 2045 年，对机组人员的需求将达到 102 万名，每年约有 40,000 个职位空缺，以支持机队增长并替换退休机组人员或转行其他职业的机组人员。预计到 2035 年，全球商用飞机机队每年将增长 2.4%，宽体飞机交付量将激增，尤其是美国和中东航空公司。
根据欧洲航空安全局 (EASA) 和美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 的规定，为了商业运营的安全，法律规定每 50 个乘客座位配备一名空乘人员。考虑到这一点，以及预计的飞机交付量，到 2044 年，仅印度和南亚地区的机队数量就会增加三倍，因此仅印度和南亚就需要约 51,000 名新机组人员。
达美航空介绍了在亚特兰大为成功候选人提供的为期七周的现场培训计划。该航空公司的招聘流程包括申请、评估、虚拟工作试用、按需面试、活动当天面试以及培训前的有条件工作邀请。达美航空还表示，其申请窗口会根据运营需要而打开和关闭。未被选中的候选人应遵循当前申请中显示的重新申请期限。大多数航空公司要求候选人至少等待三到六个月才能重新申请。

summary: Staying on a really high floor is a thrill, but naming the world's tallest and highest hotels isn't simple. Here's how the two differ, plus the top five of each.

body_en: There’s something I really love about staying in a hotel room on a really high floor, where you’re so high up that you almost feel like you’re in an airplane. So, what are the tallest and highest hotels in the world? I want to talk about that in this post, and also discuss why the answer isn’t that straightforward.
Defining the tallest & highest hotels is tricky

The question of which hotel is the tallest and highest isn’t as straightforward as you might assume. And even once we do define it, there’s the question of the extent to which the answer is actually useful. First let’s cover the distinction between the tallest hotel and the highest hotel.

Generally speaking, the tallest hotel would be defined as the tallest building where a large percent of the structure is made up of the hotel. Most commonly, I see people suggest that this would include situations where at least 80% of the building is the hotel.

This is different than the highest hotel, which would be the hotel that is highest above the ground, even if it only takes up a small percentage of a mixed-use building, where there might be apartments, residences, etc.

In other words, a 50-story building that consists exclusively of a hotel would fall into the former category, while a 110-story building where the top 10 floors are a hotel would fall into the latter category.
With that out of the way, let’s talk about the properties that are remarkable in these categories…
First, let’s cover some of the world’s tallest hotels. We’ll define this as hotels where at least 80% of the building consists of the hotel facility.

Let me of course mention one downside of very tall standalone hotels — you could end up being on a very low floor. After all, if a high-rise consists exclusively (or almost exclusively) of hotel facilities, some people will end up on very low floors. The other downside, of course, is that these hotels are necessarily huge. If you prefer boutique hotels, you won’t find any on this list.
Currently, the tallest hotel in the world is Ciel Tower Dubai. The 1,042-room hotel opened in 2024, rises to a height of 1,227 feet (374 meters), and has 82 floors.

Ciel Tower Dubai, IHG Vignette Collection , is a 1,042-room hotel, and it rises to a height of 1,227 feet (374 meters), and has 82 floors
Gevora Hotel Dubai is a 528-room hotel, and it rises to a height of 1,169 feet (356 meters), and has 75 floors
JW Marriott Marquis Dubai is a 1,608-room hotel, and it rises to a height of 1,165 feet (355 meters), and has 82 floors
Rose Rayhaan by Rotana Dubai is a 462-room hotel, and it rises to a height of 1,098 feet (333 meters), and has 72 floors
Conrad Shanghai is a 728-room hotel, and it rises to a height of 1,098 feet (333 meters), and has 60 floors
As you can see, it’s interesting (but perhaps not surprising) that all four of the world’s tallest hotels are in Dubai.

The Conrad Shanghai, meanwhile, is located in the Shimao International Plaza, and this is the perfect example of how it’s tough to define what is technically the tallest. While the building it’s in rises to such a high height, roughly 25% of that height is the spire. So technically it’s a very tall building, but the usable space isn’t as high as you’d assume.

If you ask me, the world’s highest hotels are much more interesting than the world’s tallest hotels. That’s because the world’s highest hotels typically take up the top floors of some gravity-defying skyscrapers, and therefore, they can also be boutique properties .

哪家酒店最高且最高的问题并不像您想象的那么简单。即使我们确实定义了它，仍然存在答案实际上有用的程度的问题。首先我们来了解一下最高的酒店和最高的酒店之间的区别。

title_en: Awful: American Dies After Picking Fight With MMA Fighter At Bangkok Hotel
title_zh: 可怕：美国人在曼谷酒店与综合格斗选手打架后死亡
summary: A 46-year-old American tourist died at a Bangkok hotel after reportedly grabbing an Italian guest, a reported MMA fighter, who put him in a chokehold. Here's what police say.
summary_zh: 据报道，一名 46 岁的美国游客在曼谷一家酒店抓住了一名意大利客人，据报道是一名综合格斗选手，被掐住脖子后死亡。
body_en: An American who was reportedly yelling at staff at a hotel in Thailand ended up picking a fight with the wrong guest, and it ended up costing him his life. This is both tragic and insanely irresponsible on both sides… I just don’t get what people are thinking sometimes…
American fights with Bangkok hotel staff, then Italian man

Media in Thailand is reporting on an incident that happened early this morning (Sunday, November 22, 2026), whereby a 46-year-old American tourist died at a hotel in Bangkok’s Phra Khanong area, after an altercation with a 39-year-old Italian man, who was reportedly an MMA fighter.

According to the initial police report, the American had been arguing loudly with the hotel staff at the reception desk, for reasons that are unclear as of now. As an Italian hotel guest walked past him and attempted to enter an elevator, the American reportedly grabbed him and pulled him out.

The confrontation escalated, and turned into a physical struggle, during which the Italian man placed the American man in a chokehold, until he lost consciousness. Hotel staff called emergency services, and while first responders performed CPR, the American couldn’t be revived. Police also found an abrasion on the victim’s forehead.

The Italian man remained at the scene, and told authorities that he had been acting in self-defense, after being attacked. Police took him into custody, and he potentially faces manslaughter charges, though the case is still being investigated.

The hotel at which this incident happened hasn’t yet been named, but this occurred at Sukhumvit Soi 48 — there are several hotels in that area, with the biggest “brand name” property being a Ramada Plaza by Wyndham.

I feel horribly for the family of the person who lost his life. I would have to imagine that odds are high that there were likely some substances involved here, and that this all happened after a big Saturday night out. After all, most people aren’t looking to get into a massive fight while getting their first cup of coffee in the morning (or maybe it’s just me?).

But my gosh, the “victim” here sounds like he was acting absolutely horribly, arguing with hotel staff, and then picking a fight with a random person. At the same time, that also doesn’t justify the response of getting into a conflict that leads to a fatality.

I absolutely love Thailand — the people are so friendly, the food is amazing, and the country also offers such diversity in terms of landscape, whether you want a city, a jungle, or a beach. However, there’s also no denying that the country (and particularly Bangkok) attracts a large percentage of tourists who are looking for debauchery.

None of this has anything to do with a conflict that gets to the point of costing someone their life, but I can’t help but mention that when I review hotels, I tend to take a lot of pictures in lobbies around 4-5AM, when it’s the emptiest (since I’m a morning person anyway). Virtually everywhere else in the world, there’s not a single soul awake in public. Bangkok is probably the one exception, where you see a countless number of people moving through lobbies, elevators, etc., engaged in various forms of “business.”

An American man lost his life in Bangkok early on Sunday morning, after picking a fight with the wrong person. The 46-year-old was reportedly shouting at hotel staff, and then attacked a 39-year-old Italian guest getting into the elevator unprovoked. That Italian man was reportedly an MMA fighter, who put him in a chokehold, to the point that the American lost his life. While the man claims he was acting in self defense, he now potentially faces manslaughter charges.
It’s really sad how people act sometimes. We only have one life to live, and how unfortunate to cut your life short so unnecessarily.
body_zh: 据报道，一名美国人在泰国一家酒店对工作人员大喊大叫，最终与错误的客人发生争执，最终导致他丧生。这对双方来说都是悲剧性的，也是极其不负责任的……我只是不明白人们有时在想什么……
美国人与曼谷酒店工作人员打架，然后与意大利男子打架
泰国媒体正在报道今天凌晨（2026 年 11 月 22 日星期日）发生的一起事件，一名 46 岁的美国游客在曼谷 Phra Khanong 地区的一家酒店与一名 39 岁的意大利男子发生口角后死亡，据报道该男子是综合格斗选手。
根据警方最初的报告，这名美国人一直在前台与酒店工作人员大声争吵，原因目前尚不清楚。据报道，当一名意大利酒店客人从他身边走过并试图进入电梯时，这名美国人抓住了他并将他拉了出去。
冲突升级，并演变成肢体冲突，意大利男子掐住美国男子的脖子，直到他失去知觉。酒店工作人员拨打了紧急服务电话，尽管急救人员进行了心肺复苏，但这名美国人已无法苏醒。警方还在受害者额头上发现了一道擦伤。
这名意大利男子留在现场，并告诉当局，他在遭到袭击后只是出于自卫。警方将他拘留，他可能面临过失杀人指控，但案件仍在调查中。
发生这起事件的酒店尚未公布，但事件发生在素坤逸路 48 号——该地区有几家酒店，其中最大的“品牌”酒店是温德姆华美达广场酒店。
我为死者的家人感到悲痛。我不得不想象，这里可能涉及某些物质的可能性很高，而这一切都发生在周六的一个盛大的夜晚之后。毕竟，大多数人并不想在早上喝第一杯咖啡时陷入一场大规模的争吵（或者也许只有我这么想？）。
但我的天哪，这里的“受害者”听起来表现得非常可怕，与酒店工作人员争吵，然后与随机的人打架。与此同时，这也不能证明卷入导致死亡的冲突的反应是合理的。
我非常喜欢泰国——这里的人们非常友好，食物美味，而且这个国家的风景也如此多样化，无论你想要城市、丛林还是海滩。然而，不可否认的是，这个国家（尤其是曼谷）吸引了大量寻求放荡的游客。
这些都与导致某人丧生的冲突无关，但我忍不住提到，当我评论酒店时，我倾向于在凌晨 4 点到 5 点左右在大堂拍很多照片，这个时候是最空的（因为我是一个早起的人）。几乎在世界其他地方，没有一个人在公共场合保持清醒。曼谷可能是一个例外，在那里你可以看到无数的人穿过大厅、电梯等，从事各种形式的“生意”。
周日清晨，一名美国男子在曼谷与错误的人打架后丧生。据报道，这名 46 岁的男子对酒店工作人员大喊大叫，然后无缘无故地袭击了一名进入电梯的 39 岁意大利客人。据报道，这名意大利男子是一名综合格斗选手，他掐住了他的脖子，导致这位美国人丧生。虽然该男子声称自己的行为是出于自卫，但他现在可能面临过失杀人指控。
有时人们的行为真的很可悲。我们只有一次生命，如此不必要地缩短生命是多么不幸。

Moroccan airport Routes withdrawn Casablanca Paris-Orly, Lille, Metz-Nancy-Lorraine Marrakech Paris-Orly, Lille, Bologna Agadir Paris-Orly, Lille Rabat Paris-Orly Oujda Paris-Charles de Gaulle, Lille

The nine services from Casablanca, Marrakech, Agadir and Rabat will not return for winter 2026/27 or summer 2027. The closures also end the carrier’s presence at the five French and Italian airports concerned.

The two Oujda routes were operated using Belgium-based aircraft. The final Lille service took place on 3 November, followed by Paris-CDG on 5 November. Mobilithib reported that around 50 cabin crew were based in Morocco, although the employment consequences remain undisclosed.

The Moroccan operation had its origins in Jet4you, established in 2006 and integrated into Jetairfly in 2012. During summer 2026, two Airbus A320s leased from Bulgaria Air operated services from Morocco.

TUI fly Belgium will continue serving Morocco from Belgium and the Netherlands. Its summer 2027 Brussels programme includes additional flights to Marrakech and Agadir, alongside new services to Fez and Essaouira.
