body_en: Atmos for Business is the small business rewards program of Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines, and it runs parallel to the Atmos Rewards program (Atmos for Business used to be known as the EasyBiz program).

Most major US airlines have a small business rewards program, and the intent is to offer extra rewards when businesses book travel. The good news is that even small businesses qualify for this, and it can really boost the rewards you earn.

Along those lines, in light of the recent refresh of the Atmos™ Rewards Visa Signature® Business Card ( learn more ), I think this program is worth a close look. Long story short, Atmos Rewards members could be earning up to 23.5x points per dollar spent on airfare. Based on my valuation of 1.5 cents per Atmos Rewards point, that’s the equivalent of a jaw dropping 35.25% return on eligible spending. That’s simply unrivaled.
Atmos for Business is the self-managed business travel program by Alaska and Hawaiian, intended for small and medium sized businesses.

The program is open to companies and organizations with at least $5,000 in annual travel spending, so if you’re a frequent flyer with the company and have a small business, that’s not much of a hurdle. You can add an unlimited number of employees to your account, and all of their spending counts toward that requirement.

Now, the terms suggest that you must have spent at least $5,000 or more on eligible Alaska and Hawaiian travel in the last 15 months, though in practice, that’s not directly enforced, best I can tell. After all, this is even intended to attract new businesses that may be looking to switch travel to Alaska or Hawaiian.
When a business enrolls in Atmos for Business, it’s assigned a company Atmos Rewards loyalty number. Atmos for Business then offers an impressive number of bonus rewards
Any time a traveler associated with that business flies with Alaska or Hawaiian, the business earns 1x points per dollar spent, with no caps, in addition to what the member directly earns
Any Atmos for Business flight booking earns an additional 10x points when paid for with the Atmos Rewards Business Card
Atmos Rewards members earn an additional 10% status points on top of their base earn on any ticket booked through the Atmos for Business tool
Beyond increased loyalty benefits for the business, Atmos for Business offers a platform that is supposed to make booking easier, with features like the following
A modernized flow – the booking flow closely mirrors alaskaair.com and the experience most travelers are already familiar with
Easy invites – travel managers can invite travelers through a bulk upload, shareable link or email
More payment options – accounts can house multiple payment options and dedicate them to individuals or groups
Book according to teams – travelers can be grouped into teams, making it easier to book travel by department, office location and more
Simple reporting – travel managers can monitor activity, and track travel and spending all in one spot
A robust wallet – if a ticket is canceled, any unused funds can be added to a corporate wallet and then applied to future travel for anyone
Dedicated support – a team of experts is trained and ready to assist Atmos for Business users, ensuring a high level of care
Unique benefits for intra-Hawai‘i travel – guests traveling within the state of Hawai‘i will receive two free checked bags and free standby travel to access an earlier flight on the same route
Earn up to 23.5x points per dollar with Atmos for Business

body_en: The Atmos™ Rewards Visa Signature® Business Card is the business credit card of Atmos Rewards, which is the loyalty program of Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines. The card is issued by Bank of America, and is a rebranding of the former Alaska Airlines Visa Business Card.

The card has just undergone a full refresh , and there are many reasons to consider picking up this card , especially if you fly Alaska or Hawaiian with any frequency. This post is my in-depth Atmos Rewards Business Card review, so I’d like to take a look at the card’s value proposition, for anyone who may be considering applying .
Link: Learn more about the Atmos™ Rewards Visa Signature® Business Card
Atmos Rewards Business Card summary & key details
Before I get into my Atmos Rewards Business Card review, here’s a brief summary of the key details of the card
Atmos Business Card welcome offer: 90,000 bonus points after you make $6,000 or more in purchases within the first 90 days of opening your account

Atmos Business Card rewards earn rate: Earn 10x points on flights booked on the Atmos™ for Business website, 3x points on other eligible Alaska and Hawaiian purchases, 2x points on eligible dining purchases, and 1x points on everything else

Atmos Business Card benefits & credits: First checked bag free on Alaska & Hawaiian flights, preferred boarding on Alaska & Hawaiian flights, four annual Alaska Lounge passes, free points sharing, the ability to earn status points and discount codes with spending, a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck credit once every four years
Atmos Business Card foreign transaction fees: None
Atmos Business Card best for: Someone who flies Alaska and/or Hawaiian occasionally, and values perks like a free checked bag and preferred boarding
Below are what I consider to be the pros and cons of the Atmos Rewards Business Card.

Atmos Rewards Business Card pros Atmos Rewards Business Card cons Massive welcome bonus Limited lounge access Preferred boarding & checked bag benefit Not the best card for everyday spending Solid perks for travel on Alaska & Hawaiian Limited bonus categories outside of flights Atmos Rewards Business Card welcome bonus, eligibility, & fees

The Atmos Rewards Business Card is the only business card in the Atmos Rewards ecosystem. To start, let’s cover the welcome bonus, card eligibility rules, annual fee, and more, since these are important factors that cardmembers consider.

The Atmos Rewards Business Card is offering a limited time welcome bonus where you’ll get 90,000 bonus points after you make $6,000 or more in purchases within the first 90 days of opening your account. This is the best publicly available bonus that we’ve ever seen on the card, and you can find the bonus offer history in this post .
Based on my latest miles & points valuations , Atmos Rewards points are worth 1.5 cents each, given the great uses of these rewards . That means the 90,000 points are worth $1,350 for me.

The Atmos Rewards Business Card is issued by Bank of America. The good news is that eligibility for this card is unrelated to having any other Atmos Rewards card, so you’re eligible for this card (including the bonus) if you have the Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® credit card ( learn more ) or Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® Credit Card ( learn more ).

Let me emphasize that you are eligible for this product if you have any of the previously issued personal or business HawaiianMiles Barclays cards, or any of the previously issued personal Alaska Mileage Plan cards.

Beyond that, Bank of America doesn’t have many consistent restrictions when it comes to getting approved for business cards. While Bank of America has the 2/3/4 rule and 3/12 rules, those apply to personal cards, and not business cards. Generally those with a Bank of America banking relationship also have the best odds of approval (though it’s by no means a requirement).

There’s not a consistent credit score you need to have to be approved for this card, though personally I’d hope to have a score in the “good” to “excellent” range, ideally 700+ points. However, people with lower scores have been approved, and people with higher scores have been rejected.
Applying for this card won’t count as a further card toward Chase’s 5/24 limit , in case that’s a limit you’re trying to stay under.

以下是我认为 Atmos 奖励名片的优点和缺点。

Atmos Rewards Business Card 提供限时欢迎奖金，在开户后的前 90 天内进行 6,000 美元或以上的购物，您将获得 90,000 奖励积分。这是我们在卡上见过的最好的公开奖金，您可以在这篇文章中找到奖金优惠历史记录。

我要强调的是，如果您拥有任何之前发行的个人或商业 HawaiianMiles Barclays 卡，或者任何之前发行的个人阿拉斯加里程计划卡，您就有资格获得此产品。
除此之外，美国银行在获得名片批准方面没有太多一致的限制。虽然美国银行有 2/3/4 规则和 3/12 规则，但这些规则适用于个人卡，而不是名片。一般来说，那些与美国银行有银行业务关系的人获得批准的几率也最高（尽管这绝不是一项要求）。
获得这张卡的批准并不需要一致的信用评分，但我个人希望评分在“好”到“优秀”的范围内，最好是 700 分以上。然而，分数较低的人已被批准，而分数较高的人已被拒绝。
申请这张卡不会被视为大通银行 5/24 限制的另一张卡，以防您试图遵守该限制。

Selected U.S. military contracts for March 8, 2017 U.S. NAVY Sierra Nevada Corp. , Rancho, California, is being awarded a $30,995,905 modification to a previously awarded firm-fixed-price, cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (N00174-09-D-0003) to extend the ordering period and exercise Option Year 6 for the procurement and support of the transmitting set, countermeasures AN/PLT-5, to support explosive ordnance disposal personnel. The AN/PLT-5 is a man-portable system in support of the Joint Service Explosive Ordnance Disposal Counter Radio Controlled Improvised Explosive Device Electronic Warfare program. The Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technology Division, Indian Head, Maryland, is the contracting activity. Vector Planning and Services Inc. , San Diego, is being awarded a potential $17,910,070 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide cyberspace science, research, engineering, and technology integration. Support includes innovative technology assessment and development; rapid software development and prototyping; enabling capability training; security engineering; and cybersecurity risk management. This is one of four multiple-award contracts. All awardees will have the opportunity to compete for task orders during the ordering period. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Center Pacific, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N66001-17-D-0117). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 9, 2017 U.S. MISSILE DEFENSE AGENCY Lockheed Martin Space Systems Co. , Sunnyvale, California, was awarded a $53,052,807 competitive cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for a 36-month period with no options for the Multi-Object Kill Vehicle Technology Risk Reduction (TRR) effort. This contract represents part of the Missile Defense Agency’s technology risk reduction strategy to improve performance and reduce risk for a gimbaled seeker assembly, integrated avionics assembly, component integration and testing, and an advanced seeker. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity (HQ0147-17-C-0002). U.S. NAVY ViON Corp. , Herndon, California, is being awarded a $34,790,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to provide Capacity as a Service support to Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command (Spawar) Headquarters, Spawar System Center Pacific and Spawar System Center Atlantic. The Capacity as a Service acquisition model allows Spawar to more accurately scale, up and down, its information technology (IT) infrastructure to meet evolving mission requirements. Savings are realized through no up-front costs and a “pay as you go” acquisition model, reducing waste usually associated with overbuying of IT equipment to eventually meet an expectation of mission requirement. Under this contract, ViON is responsible for providing on-demand, on-premise computing, networking and storage solutions for a variety of systems and applications for the command’s research, development, testing and evaluation core infrastructures, laboratory and data center environments. This contract includes options, which if exercised, would bring the maximum contract value to $49,990,000. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N00039-17-D-0003).
